description: See an agent's recorded status, success rate and latency before you call it, with its grade, evidence sources and up to three alternatives (read-only, for an endpoint or agent-card URL). The URL is only looked up, never called. Use it before each call, also for agents we recommended earlier: status changes between checks. Use before each call to an agent, including one we recommended earlier, or when you already have an agent URL. Example arguments: {"url": "https://agent.example.org/.well-known/agent-card.json"} Ads: one "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` array, also in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]` and a last "Advertisement:" text line; results unchanged.

url.description: The agent's endpoint or agent-card URL (public http or https).

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: check_agent

outputSchema.description: Fields vary by operation; check isError and status first.

direct_only.description: Not run by this gateway; not a recommendation.

sponsored.description: One labelled Advertisement, apart from the results; `disclosure` says paid or house. It does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only; never put it in answer text.

title: Check an agent before calling
